\n<\N[1]>Hyahahaha! Of course Hazuki's not here! Are you
really that stupid!? Your luck ran out the moment
you decided to show me that picture! Uhihihih!
\n<\N[1]>I usually put you to sleep when we do this, so I'm
really looking forward to hearing you scream and
moan your heart out tonight!
\n<\N[1]>A metal drum, clearly abandoned here illegally.
Smells like a garbage dump... Nasty stuff.
\n<\N[1]>Oh fuck, the contents of this drum are spilling out...
I guess illegal dumping is a real problem, huh?
\n<\N[1]>And obviously they chose a place where few people
can see them do it. It does fit the scenery... Few
things say crime like piles of busted drums.
\n<\N[1]>Some old containers, clearly illegally abandoned here.
The doors are rusted shut. I'll never be able to open
them... They must've been here for years and years.
